messages:
ravi: Quick thread to finalize the relnotes for the docs push (v0.11.0) - draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/974. Need short bullets, migration tip, and Known Issues.
emily: I'll add 3 concise bullets (streaming perf, batching heuristics, prefix caching example) and a 1-line migration note about streaming default change.
noah: I'll include minimal py/js snippets (1-2 lines). Example: python: from redwood import Client; Client().generate('hi', streaming=True)
link-bot: Found 1 broken link: examples/prefix-cache.md -> replace gist with repo-hosted sample.
emily: Good catch, I'll switch to inline sample and shorten examples to <=6 lines.
ravi: Known Issue to call out: embeddings endpoint may 429 under sustained high concurrency with Dedicated burst. Repro: wrk -t8 -c150 -d30s /v1/embeddings. Mitigation: client retry/backoff or route to non-burst pool.
noah: Adding note for Dedicated customers about canary rollout and automatic fallback to capacity tier B when burst exhausted.
docs-bot: CI queued: link-check + snippet-lint + build. Expect results in ~6m.
ravi: Please add one-sentence TL;DR for the announcement (<=1 sent).
emily: TL;DR: "v0.11.0 1: improved streaming performance, smarter batching, and small SDK changes (see migration notes)."
noah: LGTM. Assign reviewers: @emily @noah. Merge tomorrow 09:00 PT if CI green. :thumbsup:
